title: Zarc: Exact Nearest Neighbors over a Billion Vectors in Seconds
abstract: arXiv:2611.29252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exact k-nearest-neighbor vector search lies on the critical path of machine learning systems, from sparse attention in the latest large language models (LLMs) to long-context memories and training-data deduplication. Exhaustive GPU search scans the whole dataset for every query, while approximate indexes return inexact neighbors. Recent methods skip almost every vector with a cheap half-precision proof that it lies too far away, but only on one GPU that holds the whole dataset. Our insight is to keep only the short rows of these proofs in GPU memory and to fetch the few remaining full vectors from host memory. Our system, Zarc, answers Euclidean, cosine, inner-product, and filtered queries exactly under updates. On four H100 GPUs, it answers 10,000 exact queries over one billion vectors in 1.1 seconds instead of five minutes. On eleven open LLMs, it retrieves the exact top-10 attention keys 2.2x to 13.1x faster than exhaustive search.

translated_title: Zarc：在数秒内对十亿向量进行精确最近邻搜索
translated_abstract: 精确k近邻向量搜索处于机器学习系统的关键路径上，应用涵盖最新大型语言模型（LLM）中的稀疏注意力、长上下文记忆以及训练数据去重。穷举式GPU搜索会为每个查询扫描整个数据集，而近似索引则返回不精确的邻居。近期的方法利用一种廉价的半精度证明跳过几乎所有距离过远的向量，但该方法只能在持有整个数据集的单块GPU上运行。我们的核心洞察是：仅在GPU内存中保留这些证明的短行，并从主机内存中取回少数剩余的完整向量。我们的系统Zarc能够在数据更新情况下精确回答欧几里得距离、余弦相似度、内积以及带过滤条件的查询。在四块H100 GPU上，Zarc对十亿向量回答10,000个精确查询仅需1.1秒，而传统方法需要五分钟。在十一个开源LLM上，它检索精确top-10注意力键的速度比穷举搜索快2.2倍至13.1倍。
tldr: Zarc通过在GPU内存中仅保留短小的距离证明、并从主机内存按需取回少量完整向量，实现了在多GPU上对十亿级向量在数秒内完成精确k近邻搜索，将10,000个查询的耗时从五分钟降至1.1秒。
en_tdlr: Zarc achieves exact k-nearest-neighbor search over a billion vectors in seconds by keeping only short distance proofs in GPU memory and fetching the few remaining full vectors from host memory, reducing 10,000 queries from five minutes to 1.1 seconds.
